title: Framework discloses data breach via Metabase 0-day
summary: Framework, a modular laptop company, disclosed a data breach that occurred through a zero-day vulnerability in Metabase, an open-source business intelligence and data visualization platform. The incident highlights the risks of unpatched third-party software exposing customer data.
problem_solved: This is a security incident disclosure rather than a solution; it notifies affected users about compromised data exposure through a software vulnerability.
why_valuable: Provides real-world evidence of the danger of unpatched third-party BI tools and serves as a case study for security teams to improve their vulnerability management practices.
